$comment: Host Capability Receipt v1 contract, frozen field list. Generated by hand from WBS-70.03's own field list in the 1.0.17 convergence roadmap ('Every consequential run can identify: host, host_version, environment, pre-tool hook, enforceable deny, workspace isolation, resume, signed-in headless, structured tool events, receipt path, network control, known limitations, certification evidence, certification freshness') and mirrors docs/plan/delivery-receipt-v1.schema.json's own shape (contract_version, source_document, frozen_fields). This list grows, never shrinks: a later contract version may append a field, never remove or retype one already here. scripts/host_capability.py is the one module that computes this receipt; scripts/test_brother_run.py's ATheReceiptCarriesTheHostsCapability tests pin it against a real generated receipt.
